newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares stage technical rebound, Lek soars.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares stage technical rebound, Lek soars.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 1.34 percent on Thursday in what traders said was purely a technical rebound after recent losses.
Gains also fuelled by strong performance of drug maker Lek's A issue.
* The SBI index rose 16.91 points to 1,277.69.
* Overall eight shares rose, four fell and three were unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
* Lek's A issue was the most active, jumping 5.38 percent to 23,890 tolars on volume of 1,284 shares.
